title: TwelveSpec Decoration and Customization Library
scope: Category-level applicability; not a verified per-SKU supplier capability feed

methods.name: Flat embroidery
methods.best_for: Clean stitched logos on caps, polos, bags
methods.limitation: Tiny lettering/gradients; construction and stitch count
methods.web_description: Thread stitched directly into the product for a classic professional finish.

methods.name: 3D puff embroidery
methods.web_description: Raised embroidery adds dimension to bold lettering and simple marks.

methods.name: Chain-stitch embroidery
methods.web_description: A decorative stitched texture with a heritage look.

methods.name: Applique / tackle twill
methods.best_for: Large athletic letters and varsity graphics
methods.web_description: Fabric shapes stitched onto apparel for a layered athletic look.

methods.name: Embroidered patch
methods.web_description: A textured stitched emblem attached to a garment or cap.

methods.name: Woven patch / label
methods.best_for: Detailed logos, small text, woven branding
methods.limitation: Flat appearance rather than puffy texture
methods.web_description: Finely woven threads preserve intricate logos on hats and apparel.

methods.name: Leather / leatherette patch
methods.web_description: A distinctive textured patch that can be engraved, debossed, or printed.

methods.name: PVC / rubber patch
methods.web_description: A flexible raised emblem with bold shape and texture.

methods.name: Chenille / felt patch
methods.web_description: Soft, dimensional lettering with a classic varsity feel.

methods.name: Printed / sublimated patch
methods.best_for: Detailed full-color logos on cap or bag
methods.limitation: Edge, backing and color durability vary
methods.web_description: A full-color emblem suitable for detailed artwork.

methods.name: Silicone / dimensional emblem
methods.best_for: Modern premium uniforms and performance style
methods.web_description: A smooth raised emblem with a refined technical look.

methods.name: Direct screen printing
methods.best_for: Bulk cotton tees, totes, promotional fabrics
methods.limitation: Screen/setup costs, seams and variable print areas
methods.web_description: Ink applied through screens; great for bold designs at volume.

methods.name: Water-based / discharge screen print
methods.best_for: Soft-hand prints on suitable cotton apparel
methods.web_description: A softer, integrated print look on compatible garments.

methods.name: Specialty screen inks
methods.best_for: Puff, metallic, glitter, high-density, reflective effects
methods.limitation: Higher cost; wash and substrate test
methods.web_description: Screen printing with additional texture or specialty visual effects.

methods.name: Screen-printed heat transfer
methods.best_for: Consistent batch logos, uniforms, repeat orders
methods.web_description: Screen-printed ink prepared offsite and applied with heat and pressure.

methods.name: Digital/screen hybrid transfer
methods.best_for: Detailed full-color graphics with an ink-like finish
methods.web_description: Combines digital detail with selected screen-printed layers.

methods.name: Direct-to-film (DTF) transfer
methods.best_for: Full-color art, short runs, complex multi-color logos
methods.limitation: Hand feel/opacity and wash durability vary
methods.web_description: A digitally printed design transferred to the garment with heat.

methods.name: Direct-to-garment (DTG)
methods.best_for: Photographic art on compatible cotton-rich garments
methods.web_description: Full-color ink printed directly onto the garment.

methods.name: Heat transfer vinyl (HTV)
methods.web_description: Cut film applied with a heat press for lettering and simple graphics.

methods.name: Print-and-cut heat transfer
methods.web_description: A full-color printed film cut to the shape of the artwork.

methods.name: Silicone / stretch / blocker transfer
methods.web_description: A specialized transfer formulated for stretch and heat-sensitive textiles.

methods.name: Reflective heat-transfer print
methods.limitation: Not equivalent to certified safety reflective material
methods.web_description: Reflective decoration that catches light for a high-visibility effect.

methods.name: Dye sublimation - garment or textile
methods.best_for: White/light polyester apparel and fabric displays
methods.limitation: Not a white-ink process; no dark cotton
methods.web_description: Color infused into compatible polyester fibers.

methods.name: Cut-and-sew all-over printing
methods.best_for: Full-coverage custom polyester jerseys and polos
methods.limitation: Different from pressing a premade dark or beige shirt
methods.web_description: Print fabric panels before sewing for edge-to-edge designs.

methods.name: Custom knitting / jacquard
methods.limitation: Custom production minimums and art simplification
methods.web_description: The design is built into knitted or woven construction.

methods.name: Laser engraving / marking
methods.best_for: Steel tumblers, anodized metals, wood, leatherette
methods.limitation: Mark color depends on coating and substrate
methods.web_description: A precise, lasting design formed by laser energy on compatible materials.

methods.name: Pad printing
methods.limitation: Limited image area, spot colors, setup
methods.web_description: Ink transferred with a pad onto compact or shaped products.

methods.name: Hardgoods screen print
methods.best_for: Spot-color drinkware and flat promo items
methods.web_description: Screen-print branding on approved hard surfaces.

methods.name: Rotary / wrap screen printing
methods.web_description: A screen-printed design wrapped around approved drinkware.

methods.name: Direct UV / digital inkjet printing
methods.best_for: Full-color gifts, pens, tech, rigid goods
methods.web_description: Full-color ink printed directly on a compatible surface.

methods.name: UV DTF applied decal
methods.best_for: Complex full-color branding on approved hard goods
methods.web_description: A transfer-applied raised graphic for suitable hard products.

methods.name: Sublimation on coated goods
methods.limitation: Requires special coating; no uncoated ceramics
methods.web_description: Full-color art heat-infused into specially coated items.

methods.name: Ceramic / glass decal printing
methods.limitation: Firing process and safe-use rules depend on item
methods.web_description: Specialized decals used on compatible ceramic or glass drinkware.

methods.name: Sandblast / etched glass
methods.web_description: Physical surface etching for a subtle premium look.

methods.name: Deboss / blind stamp
methods.limitation: Requires compatible substrate and often a die
methods.web_description: A logo pressed into the surface for a tactile impression.

methods.name: Emboss / raised relief
methods.web_description: A raised impression adds dimension to printed pieces.

methods.name: Hot foil / digital foil
methods.web_description: Metallic or colored foil for an elevated finish.

methods.name: Epoxy resin dome
methods.limitation: Thickness, outdoor UV, and edge constraints
methods.web_description: A clear raised coating that gives a logo dimensional shine.

methods.name: Die cast / enamel / molded emblem
methods.web_description: Raised or colored metal brand marks produced from a custom mold.

methods.name: Digital print (sheetfed)
methods.web_description: Digital ink or toner prints high-resolution color efficiently for shorter runs.

methods.name: Offset lithography
methods.web_description: Traditional press printing for consistent, economical large runs.

methods.name: Flexographic print
methods.web_description: Continuous roll-fed printing for high-volume labels and packages.

methods.name: Letterpress
methods.web_description: A tactile impression made by a relief printing process.

methods.name: White ink / spot white
methods.web_description: An opaque white layer beneath or beside artwork.

methods.name: Spot UV / raised UV
methods.limitation: Not a standalone full-color print method
methods.web_description: Selective gloss or raised clear coating creates contrast.

methods.name: Gloss/matte/soft-touch lamination
methods.web_description: A protective film changes sheen, feel and resistance.

methods.name: Die-cut / contour cut
methods.limitation: Die/cut line and safe area required
methods.web_description: Custom trim shapes and windows for print and packaging.

methods.name: Variable-data personalization
methods.web_description: Personalized names, addresses, codes or versioned designs.

methods.name: Wide-format UV inkjet
methods.best_for: Rigid signs, display film, banner media
methods.limitation: Rigid/flexible media and outdoor spec vary
methods.web_description: Full-color UV-cured ink for signage and displays.

methods.name: Eco-solvent / latex wide-format
methods.web_description: Durable large-format printing on selected flexible films.

methods.name: Plotter-cut adhesive vinyl
methods.limitation: Limited to cut shapes/colors without printed film
methods.web_description: Cut lettering and shapes in adhesive vinyl.

methods.name: Dye-sublimated fabric graphics
methods.best_for: SEG fabric, flags, trade-show table throws
methods.limitation: Polyester fabric system and sewn fit
methods.web_description: Edge-to-edge full-color printing on display fabric.

methods.name: UV roll-to-roll display printing
methods.limitation: Film suitability, curl, finish and hardware fit
methods.web_description: UV printed graphics for flexible large display media.

methods.name: Sewn display finish / SEG beading
methods.web_description: Fabric seams, pockets, hems, or silicone-edge beading.
